item_short_desc: Rothco's Antiriot Shield offers robust protection for law enforcement personnel, constructed from tough, transparent polycarbonate material. This clear shield measures 40 inch x 20 inch x 1/8 inch thick, providing comprehensive coverage for the torso while allowing full visibility. Weighing only 6 pounds, it is lightweight and easy to maneuver, ensuring quick and responsive use in dynamic situations. The solid cast aluminum handle offers an optimal grip, while the web arm strap ensures additional security and stability during use.
